name: fitness-duo-collage-night-gym
image_purpose: fitness lifestyle social content and motivational collage

prompt.project_info: Create a side-by-side fitness portrait collage featuring two adult women showcasing confident athletic looks in different settings.
prompt.main_subject: Two adult athletic women with original fictional identities. The left subject has medium-length wavy blonde hair and wears a bright yellow fitted athletic top with matching high-waisted leggings. The right subject has red hair in a high ponytail and wears a light purple supportive sports top with matching high-waisted fitness bottoms. Both have natural realistic skin texture, natural proportions, and confident positive expressions.
prompt.composition_elements: Side-by-side collage with two distinct panels. Left panel: the blonde adult woman stands sideways on a balcony or terrace at night, looking back over her shoulder with a calm confident expression, city lights behind her. Right panel: the red-haired adult woman raises both arms overhead while holding an orange workout bar, smiling brightly in an indoor gym with exercise balls and workout equipment visible. Keep each panel's setting and pose distinct while maintaining a cohesive modern fitness-lifestyle composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use soft natural night light and city glow in the balcony panel, and soft even indoor gym lighting in the exercise panel. The overall mood is bold, stylish, powerful, active, positive, empowering, and vibrant.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic side-by-side fitness portrait collage, sharp facial and fabric detail, realistic anatomy and skin texture, balanced panel spacing, natural perspective, controlled highlights, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic side-by-side fitness portrait collage featuring two adult athletic women with original fictional identities. In the left panel, show an adult woman with medium-length wavy blonde hair wearing a bright yellow fitted athletic top and matching high-waisted leggings, standing sideways on a balcony or terrace at night, looking back over her shoulder with a calm confident expression and city lights behind her. Preserve natural realistic skin texture, natural proportions, distinct panel settings, soft night and gym lighting, bold stylish fitness energy, positive motivating mood, balanced collage spacing, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish styling, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, transparent clothing, exposed nipples, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, duplicate subjects, mismatched faces, plastic skin, waxy skin, over-smooth skin, airbrushed skin, HDR look, oversaturated colors, unreadable text, logos, watermark
